summary: GCT Semiconductor filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to upsize its existing at-the-market (ATM) offering program from $75M to a total of $120M of common stock. The sales agreement, dated April 1, 2025, is with B. Riley Securities and H.C. Wainwright as sales agents. Shares are sold at prevailing market prices; the last reported price was $2.61 on June 15, 2026. Agents receive up to 3.0% commission. No escrow or trust arrangement exists. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No deal terms or special-situation characteristics are present.
